changeSet.author: cagdas.tunca
changeSet.sql: create or replace function jinear_fts_fold(value text) returns text language sql immutable parallel safe as $$ select translate(value, 'ıIİşŞçÇğĞöÖüÜ', 'iiissccggoouu') $$

create or replace function jinear_fts_prefix_query(value text) returns tsquery language sql immutable parallel safe as $$ select to_tsquery('simple', regexp_replace(nullif(trim(regexp_replace(jinear_fts_fold(value), '[^\w\s]', ' ', 'g')), ''), '\s+', ':* & ', 'g') || ':*') $$

changeSet.author: cagdas.tunca
changeSet.sql:
create materialized view mv_note_fts as select n.note_id, n.workspace_id, setweight(to_tsvector('simple', jinear_fts_fold(coalesce(n.title, ''::text))), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', jinear_fts_fold(coalesce(rt.value, ''::text))), 'B') as fts from note n left join rich_text rt on rt.rich_text_id = n.rich_text_id and rt.passive_id is null where n.passive_id is null;
create index idx_mv_note_fts_fts_search on mv_note_fts using gin (fts); create unique index idx_mv_note_fts_note_id on mv_note_fts (note_id);

changeSet.author: cagdas.tunca
cagdas.tunca
changeSet.sql:
create materialized view mv_material_fts as select m.material_id, m.workspace_id, setweight(to_tsvector('simple', regexp_replace(jinear_fts_fold(coalesce(m.name, ''::text)), '[^\w]+', ' ', 'g')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', regexp_replace(jinear_fts_fold(coalesce(md.original_name, ''::text)), '[^\w]+', ' ', 'g')), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', regexp_replace(coalesce(md.content_type, ''::text), '[^\w]+', ' ', 'g')), 'C') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', jinear_fts_fold(coalesce(owner_username.username, ''::text))), 'D') as fts from material m left join media md on md.media_id = m.media_id left join lateral (select u.username from username u where u.related_object_id = m.owner_id and u.related_object_type = 'ACCOUNT' and u.passive_id is null order by u.idate desc limit 1) owner_username on true where m.passive_id is null;
create index idx_mv_material_fts_fts_search on mv_material_fts using gin (fts); create unique index idx_mv_material_fts_material_id on mv_material_fts (material_id);
